reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, shared applyWeekendRule (the same weekend rule getUpcomingDates and getNextDate use) and the months day helpers.

duplication.why: The RSchedule construction, try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper and the occurrence -> applyWeekendRule -> dayFromDate flatMap mirror getUpcomingDates; a small repeated block, not a reimplementation of the rule.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and clear, with the weekend-margin reasoning commented; the expansion/mapping skeleton shared with getUpcomingDates could have been factored.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend handling goes through the shared applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: The occurrence-mapping flatMap in getDatesInRange is a visible copy of the one in getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts), not disguised.
